tabs.html:
MikroTik hAP ax lite (L41G-2axD) — 600 Mbps Wi-Fi 6 Router


The MikroTik hAP ax lite (L41G-2axD) is a compact yet powerful Wi-Fi 6 router designed for modern homes, small offices, and Bangladeshi ISP networks. Offering up to 600 Mbps wireless speed, advanced RouterOS features, and reliable hardware, this router delivers exceptional performance at an affordable price.

Key Features

  • Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax) with speeds up to 574 Mbps on 2.4 GHz
  • Dual-core ARM IPQ-5010 CPU at 800 MHz
  • 256 MB RAM and 128 MB NAND storage
  • 4× Gigabit Ethernet ports for high-speed wired connectivity
  • Dual-chain 2.4 GHz antenna with up to 4.3 dBi gain
  • Runs on RouterOS v7, License Level 4
  • Compact, fanless design with low power consumption

Technical Specifications


Performance & Hardware

  • CPU: Dual-core ARM IPQ-5010, 800 MHz
  • RAM: 256 MB
  • Storage: 128 MB NAND
  • Switch Chipset: MT7531BE
  • Operating System: RouterOS v7 (License L4)

Wireless

  • Band: 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi 6 (802.11b/g/n/ax)
  • Max Wireless Data Rate: 574 Mbps
  • Chains: 2×2 MIMO
  • Antenna Gain: Up to 4.3 dBi

Ethernet

  • 4× 10/100/1000 Gigabit Ethernet ports

Power & Physical

  • Power Input: USB-C, 5 V nominal
  • Max Power Consumption: 8 W
  • Cooling: Passive (fanless)
  • Dimensions: 124 × 100 × 54 mm
  • Operating Temperature: –40 °C to +70 °C
